title: Phil Woods and Zoot Sims drunk on the Soviet tour
summary: Zoot and Phil drink Russian wine all tour, and Zoot photographs the trip on a roll of film he never changes.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: To wrap this up a little bit, can
you think of any tours or anything, some bands that might have given you a good laughs? When you went to Russia with Benny Goodman, you were on that first tour?

Yeah, that was pretty funny. You know, you don't like to tell tales out of school but I guess everybody knows that Zoot does take a drink once in a while and at that time, so did Phil Woods. And these guys were bombed from the start to the finish. And they drank the Russian wine and the Russians were sitting there looking at them like they're something from Mars, you know. But they secretly -- they did not like Benny, they hated him. They would spit when you mentioned his name because he gave them a hard time about sound and everything and they didn't feel like working that much so they didn't like him. But they all were fascinated.

And Zoot was taking photographs all through the Soviet Union and all of a sudden we realized nobody ever saw him put film in the camera. And Phil said, 'Man, what are you taking all those pictures for? You're so goddamned drunk you don't know where you are.' And Zoot said, 'That's why I'm taking them, man, when I get home I'll look at the pictures and know where I was.'
And Phil said, 'Yeah, but you never change the film, you keep doing the same one over and over.' Zoot said, 'Yeah, it's cheaper that way.'
